methodology.description: Code Provenance Score measures the average longevity of a contributor's code in the repository.
steps: Clone the PostHog repository with history from the last 90 days
Parse all commits chronologically, extracting line-level diffs
Track each line's author and introduction timestamp
When a line is modified or deleted by a different author, record its lifespan
For surviving lines, calculate lifespan as days from introduction to analysis end date
Compute the arithmetic mean of all line lifespans per contributor
Filter out contributors with fewer than 10 lines, rank top 5 by score
